importantXMLs.description: Sets the width of the view to match its parent container
Sets the height of the view to wrap its content
Sets the text content of a TextView or Button
Sets the size of text in scale-independent pixels
Sets the color of the text
Sets the background color or drawable of a view
Sets padding on all sides of the view
Sets margin on all sides of the view (used with layout_ prefix)

Assigns a unique ID to a view for reference in code
Controls the alignment of content within a view
Controls the alignment of the view within its parent
Sets the orientation of LinearLayout (vertical or horizontal)
Sets the source image for an ImageView
Controls how an image should be scaled and positioned
Sets the hint text for EditText fields

Sets the maximum number of lines for a TextView
importantXMLs.example:
<TextView
    android:layout_width="match_parent"
    android:layout_height="wrap_content"
    android:maxLines="2"
    android:text="This text will be limited to two lines maximum" />

importantXMLs.description: Controls how text is truncated when it overflows
importantXMLs.example:
<TextView
    android:layout_width="100dp"
    android:layout_height="wrap_content"
    android:ellipsize="end"
    android:singleLine="true"
    android:text="Very long text that will be truncated" />

importantXMLs.description: Adds a drawable to the left of the text
importantXMLs.example:
<TextView
    android:layout_width="wrap_content"
    android:layout_height="wrap_content"
    android:drawableLeft="@drawable/icon"
    android:text="Text with icon" />

importantXMLs.description: Sets the checked state of checkable views
importantXMLs.example:
<CheckBox
    android:layout_width="wrap_content"
    android:layout_height="wrap_content"
    android:checked="true"
    android:text="Agree to terms" />

importantXMLs.description: Enables or disables a view
Controls whether a view can be clicked
Controls whether a view can receive focus
Distributes extra space in proportion to weight values
Sets the minimum height of a view
importantXMLs.example:
<TextView
    android:layout_width="match_parent"
    android:layout_height="wrap_content"
    android:minHeight="60dp"
    android:text="Minimum height text" />

importantXMLs.description: Sets the minimum width of a view
Sets the maximum width of a view
importantXMLs.example:
<TextView
    android:layout_width="wrap_content"
    android:layout_height="wrap_content"
    android:maxWidth="150dp"
    android:text="This text will not exceed maximum width" />

importantXMLs.description: Sets the maximum height of a view
Aligns view to the top of its parent (RelativeLayout)
Centers view within its parent (RelativeLayout)
Positions view below another view (RelativeLayout)
importantXMLs.example:
<TextView
    android:id="@+id/title"
    android:layout_width="wrap_content"
    android:layout_height="wrap_content"
    android:text="Title" />
<TextView
    android:layout_width="wrap_content"
    android:layout_height="wrap_content"
    android:layout_below="@id/title"
    android:text="Subtitle" />

importantXMLs.description: Positions view above another view (RelativeLayout)
importantXMLs.example:
<Button
    android:id="@+id/button"
    android:layout_width="wrap_content"
    android:layout_height="wrap_content"
    android:text="Button" />
<TextView
    android:layout_width="wrap_content"
    android:layout_height="wrap_content"
    android:layout_above="@id/button"
    android:text="Text above button" />

importantXMLs.description: Positions view to the right of another view (RelativeLayout)
importantXMLs.example:
<ImageView
    android:id="@+id/icon"
    android:layout_width="40dp"
    android:layout_height="40dp"
    android:src="@drawable/icon" />
<TextView
    android:layout_width="wrap_content"
    android:layout_height="wrap_content"
    android:layout_toRightOf="@id/icon"
    android:text="Text to right" />

importantXMLs.description: Positions view to the left of another view (RelativeLayout)
importantXMLs.example:
<Button
    android:id="@+id/button"
    android:layout_width="wrap_content"
    android:layout_height="wrap_content"
    android:text="Button" />
<TextView
    android:layout_width="wrap_content"
    android:layout_height="wrap_content"
    android:layout_toLeftOf="@id/button"
    android:text="Left text" />

importantXMLs.description: Aligns top edge with another view (RelativeLayout)
importantXMLs.example:
<TextView
    android:id="@+id/reference"
    android:layout_width="wrap_content"
    android:layout_height="wrap_content"
    android:text="Reference" />
<TextView
    android:layout_width="wrap_content"
    android:layout_height="wrap_content"
    android:layout_alignTop="@id/reference"
    android:text="Aligned Top" />

importantXMLs.description: Aligns bottom edge with another view (RelativeLayout)
importantXMLs.example:
<TextView
    android:id="@+id/reference"
    android:layout_width="wrap_content"
    android:layout_height="wrap_content"
    android:text="Reference" />
<TextView
    android:layout_width="wrap_content"
    android:layout_height="wrap_content"
    android:layout_alignBottom="@id/reference"
    android:text="Aligned Bottom" />

importantXMLs.description: Sets the transparency of a view (0.0 to 1.0)

Scales the view horizontally
Scales the view vertically
Moves the view horizontally by specified distance
Moves the view vertically by specified distance
Sets the elevation (shadow depth) of a view
Provides accessibility description for non-text views
Controls accessibility importance of a view
importantXMLs.example:
<TextView
    android:layout_width="wrap_content"
    android:layout_height="wrap_content"
    android:importantForAccessibility="yes"
    android:text="Important for accessibility" />

importantXMLs.description: Allows view to gain focus when touched
importantXMLs.example:
<EditText
    android:layout_width="match_parent"
    android:layout_height="wrap_content"
    android:focusableInTouchMode="true"
    android:hint="Touch to focus" />

importantXMLs.description: Specifies next view to focus when pressing down
importantXMLs.example:
<EditText
    android:id="@+id/first_field"
    android:layout_width="match_parent"
    android:layout_height="wrap_content"
    android:nextFocusDown="@id/second_field"
    android:hint="First field" />

importantXMLs.description: Specifies next view to focus when pressing up
importantXMLs.example:
<EditText
    android:id="@+id/second_field"
    android:layout_width="match_parent"
    android:layout_height="wrap_content"
    android:nextFocusUp="@id/first_field"
    android:hint="Second field" />

importantXMLs.description: Sets soft keyboard options for EditText
Sets the exact number of lines for a TextView
importantXMLs.example:
<EditText
    android:layout_width="match_parent"
    android:layout_height="wrap_content"
    android:lines="3"
    android:hint="Three lines text" />

importantXMLs.description: Restricts text to a single line
importantXMLs.example:
<TextView
    android:layout_width="match_parent"
    android:layout_height="wrap_content"
    android:singleLine="true"
    android:text="Single line text that will be truncated if too long" />

importantXMLs.description: Sets text style (bold, italic, normal)
importantXMLs.example:
<TextView
    android:layout_width="wrap_content"
    android:layout_height="wrap_content"
    android:textStyle="bold|italic"
    android:text="Bold and Italic" />

importantXMLs.description: Sets the font family for text
Forces text to be displayed in all caps
Sets spacing between letters
Adds extra spacing between lines of text
importantXMLs.example:
<TextView
    android:layout_width="match_parent"
    android:layout_height="wrap_content"
    android:lineSpacingExtra="8sp"
    android:text="Line one
Line two
Line three" />

importantXMLs.description: Sets padding between drawable and text
importantXMLs.example:
<TextView
    android:layout_width="wrap_content"
    android:layout_height="wrap_content"
    android:drawableLeft="@drawable/icon"
    android:drawablePadding="15dp"
    android:text="Text with padding" />

importantXMLs.description: Sets divider drawable for LinearLayout

    android:dividerPadding="15dp"

importantXMLs.description: Enables sound effects for view interactions
importantXMLs.example:
<Button
    android:layout_width="wrap_content"
    android:layout_height="wrap_content"
    android:soundEffectsEnabled="true"

importantXMLs.description: Enables haptic feedback for view interactions
importantXMLs.example:
<Button
    android:layout_width="wrap_content"
    android:layout_height="wrap_content"
    android:hapticFeedbackEnabled="true"

importantXMLs.description: Filters touches when view is obscured for security
Enables context clicking (right-click/long-press)

    android:layout_width="wrap_content"
    android:layout_height="wrap_content"

Sets the selector drawable for items in the dropdown (pressed state highlight).
Sets the width of the dropdown menu. Can be a dimension, 'match_parent', or 'wrap_content'.
Sets the vertical offset from the Spinner where the dropdown should appear.
Sets the horizontal offset from the Spinner where the dropdown should appear.
Sets the gravity of the selected item text within the Spinner button.
Sets the title text for the dropdown dialog (when in dialog mode).
Sets the display mode: 'dropdown' (default) or 'dialog' (separate dialog window).
Populates the Spinner directly with items from a string array defined in arrays.xml.
Applies a specific theme to the dropdown popup (API 23+).
Sets a custom animation style for the dropdown showing/hiding.
For Material Design Spinner. Sets the elevation of the dropdown popup.
Sets a custom background for the Spinner's closed state.
Applies a tint to the Spinner's background.
Sets the blending mode for the background tint.
Sets the text appearance for the selected item.
Sets the text color for the selected item.
Sets the text size for the selected item.
Sets padding inside the Spinner button.
Sets padding between the text and the dropdown arrow icon.
Sets a custom drawable to the right of the text (replaces default arrow).
Sets a custom drawable to the end of the text (RTL-aware version of drawableRight).
Allows the Spinner to receive focus for keyboard navigation.
Enables or disables clicking on the Spinner. Usually always true.
Provides an accessibility description for the Spinner.
importantXMLs.example: <Spinner android:contentDescription="Choose an option from the list" ... />
